text:
Predicates:
MemberOfPappys(x) ::: x is a member of Pappy's.
StarredIn(x, y) ::: x starred in y.
Show(y) ::: y is a show.
PilotedIn(y, z) ::: y was piloted in z.
Title(y, t) ::: y has title t.
ScriptEditor(x, y) ::: x was the script editor for y.
Premises:
Badults :: a British sitcom series starring members of Pappy's.
PilotedIn(Badults, July2013) ::: Badults was piloted in July 2013.
Title(Badults, "The Secret Dude Society") ::: The working title 'The Secret Dude Society' was used for Badults.
ScriptEditor(AndrewCollins, Badults) ::: Andrew Collins was the script editor for Badults.
Conclusion:
¬∃x (MemberOfPappys(x) ∧ StarredIn(x, Badults) ∧ (PilotedIn(Badults, July2013) ∧ (PilotedIn(Badults, July2013) → (BBCTwo ∨ BBCThree)))) ::: No members of Pappy's have starred in a show piloting on BBC Two or BBC Three.
